title: Transform segmentation images and masks together
prompt: Resize CHW image and HW categorical mask together, bilinear for image and nearest for mask; optionally flip both horizontally. Return image, integer mask, nonzero-mask area fraction, and inclusion flag. This deterministic transform core treats all nonzero labels as organ and preserves class IDs.
